en.summary: Recent updates bring powerful new monitoring capabilities and AI-driven insights to help you proactively manage your database environment. Redgate Assistant now provides intelligent analysis on Server overview pages, while new alert types for PostgreSQL table bloat and repeated SQL Server login failures catch critical issues earlier. The platform now supports MongoDB over TLS connections and PostgreSQL Aurora DB cluster monitoring, expanding your visibility across diverse database platforms. Enhanced reporting with modern dashboards and improved percentile metrics give your team clearer insights into performance trends, while Docker container support and improved REST API make integration easier than ever.

highlights: Redgate Assistant is now available on SQL Server overview pages to provide AI-powered insights and recommendations
Azure Flex hosts can authenticate using user-assigned managed identities, simplifying cloud credential management
Virtual machines estate page now shows performance percentiles (P50, P95, P99) for better understanding of baseline performance patterns
New PostgreSQL Aurora DB instance view graphs CloudWatch metrics across all instances in your cluster
MongoDB connections can now use TLS with support for self-signed certificates and customizable timeouts

New Reports experience is now default with enhanced tiles and modern interface for better visibility into your estate

Alert notifications now include the actual value and threshold that triggered the alert for faster issue understanding
PostgreSQL server overview now includes Configuration tab showing current parameters and recommendations for important settings
New Server configuration page consolidates SQL Server and PostgreSQL configuration monitoring in one view
New Security user role allows read-only access to Security pages without full admin permissions
PostgreSQL table bloat alert detects when dead tuples exceed your threshold, helping prevent performance degradation

de.summary: Aktuelle Updates bringen leistungsstarke neue Überwachungsfunktionen und KI-gestützte Erkenntnisse, um Ihre Datenbankumgebung proaktiv zu verwalten. Redgate Assistant bietet nun intelligente Analysen auf Serverübersichtsseiten, während neue Alarmtypen für PostgreSQL-Tabellenbloat und wiederholte SQL Server-Anmeldungsfehler kritische Probleme früher erkennen. Die Plattform unterstützt nun MongoDB über TLS-Verbindungen und PostgreSQL Aurora DB-Cluster-Überwachung, um Ihre Sichtbarkeit über verschiedene Datenbankplattformen zu erweitern. Verbesserte Berichterstellung mit modernen Dashboards und verbesserten Perzentil-Metriken geben Ihrem Team klarere Einblicke in Leistungstrends, während Docker-Container-Unterstützung und verbessertes REST API die Integration einfacher denn je machen.
